title: ReFood
description: Resource pack that changes the texture of food to a custom one
body:
ReFood is a complete resource pack that redefines every food item in Minecraft. Every meal is now vibrant, detailed, and looks delicious

Main Features:

- **47 Custom Items:** Every single food item has been hand-drawn from scratch

- **Chocolate Cake:** A full redesign of the cake. Includes the inventory item and the 3D block model textures (top, side, inner, bottom)
  
- **Bronze Apples:** A unique aesthetic choice. Golden apples are now replaced with a sleek, polished bronze look.
  
- **Optimized Palette:** Deep, saturated colors for cooked meats to distinguish them from raw variants at a glance

- **Vanilla+ Style:** Designed to blend perfectly with default Minecraft textures

**Technical Details:**
**Resolution:** 16x16
**Compatibility:** Works on all versions from 1.16.5 up to 26.1.1
